About the Role 

 State Street Investment Management’s Data, Analytics and AI Services team is seeking an AI Engineer – Agentic Systems to build, test, deploy, and measure agentic AI solutions that transform business workflows across the investment management organization. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who takes defined and scoped AI use cases from prototype to production, turning them into reliable, governed, and auditable AI agents that connect to enterprise data and applications. The successful candidate will address data readiness and integration challenges, build rigorous evaluation and auditability into every solution, and ensure deployed agents deliver measurable workflow improvements while meeting the strong governance, risk, and control standards of a regulated financial-services environment. Working closely with the Senior Principal Architect for Agentic and MLOps Operations, business stakeholders, data and platform teams, and control partners, this role is an opportunity to be a founding member of a growing agentic AI engineering capability.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Design, build, and deliver production-grade agentic AI solutions, from prototype through deployment, that automate and enhance business workflows across the investment management organization.
 Assess and address data readiness at the outset of each solution: profile, map, and validate source data; resolve quality and access gaps; and build pipelines, APIs, or semantic layers that make existing systems and data consumable by AI agents.
 Develop agent logic, including prompts, retrieval, tool/API integrations, and orchestration, connecting agents to enterprise data sources and business applications.
 Implement deterministic validation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop approval steps to ensure AI outputs are accurate and safe for business decisions.
 Build end-to-end auditability into every solution capturing inputs, data sources, model versions, tool calls, outputs, and human approvals. Produce documentation and evidence for governance, risk, compliance, and audit reviews.
 Create test sets and evaluation pipelines to verify accuracy, grounding, reliability, and resilience against edge cases and adversarial inputs such as prompt injection.
 Partner with business users during user acceptance testing to validate that solutions deliver the intended workflow improvements, and refine solutions based on feedback.
 Deploy, monitor, and maintain solutions via CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code, tracking quality, latency, cost, and business outcome metrics, and troubleshooting, tuning, and upgrading solutions in production.
 
 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 3+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on experience building AI/ML or LLM-based applications (production experience preferred).
 Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade APIs, services, and integrations with enterprise systems.
 Strong SQL and data engineering skills, including data profiling, quality validation, transformation, and pipeline development across structured and unstructured enterprise data sources.
 Hands-on experience building agentic AI solutions, including LLM tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and multi-step orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK, or similar.
 Solid working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, particularly Vertex AI, Gemini models, and BigQuery, along with core GCP compute, storage, networking, and IAM services.
 Experience designing LLM evaluation and testing approaches, including test datasets, accuracy and grounding metrics, regression testing, and guardrails against prompt injection and unsafe outputs.
 Experience building auditable AI systems, including decision traceability, audit logging, lineage of data and model versions, and records of human approvals.
 Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), containerization, observability, and cloud security practices such as identity federation, secrets management, and least-privilege access.
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with business users through acceptance testing and to document solutions for technical, risk, and governance audiences.
 
 Nice to Have 

 Experience with Microsoft Azure and Entra ID, and building on Microsoft 365 data (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) via Microsoft Graph or Copilot extensibility.
 Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise SaaS and data sources such as Salesforce CRM, Marketo, master data management (MDM), and cloud-hosted or on-premises systems, including via Model Context Protocol (MCP) or API enablement of legacy systems; familiarity with TypeScript or Java for building integrations and services.
 Experience delivering AI solutions in financial services or another regulated industry, including familiarity with model risk management, Responsible AI, data privacy, and investment management data.
 
 Salary Range: 
$70,000 - $118,750 Annual 
 The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. 
 
 Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans. 
 For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home . 

 About State Street 

 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.
